subject: Lynx Retail — renewal: proposed term structure, hosted commit & billing path
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@lynxretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Lynx Retail — renewal: proposed term structure, hosted commit & billing path

Hi Sara —

Great speaking with you earlier about Lynx's usage pattern and expected seasonal upticks. Attached is a concise proposal and a mutual action plan that lays out two options for the hosted API renewal and commit structure:

- Option A (12-month): 2.5M tokens/month committed, standard rate band, 3% onboarding credit applied to month 1 invoice.
- Option B (24-month): 2.25M tokens/month committed, lower per-token rate, 6% onboarding credit and a 15% net discount on base over year 1.

Key operational notes:
- Soft-throttle behavior unchanged — we keep your burst pocket at 25% of committed capacity; overflow will be billed at overage rates documented in the PDF.
- Rate-limiting: we propose keeping the existing per-connection token limit but increasing the per-route QPS cap for the ‘checkout-recommend’ route to avoid latency under peak traffic.
- SOC2 / procurement: I included a short checklist in the MAP for the procurement and security teams.

Ask: can you confirm which option your finance/procurement team prefers and an expected sign-by date? If Option B looks like a fit, we can prepare a 24-month amendment and route to DocuSign this week.

Attachments: Lynx_Retail_Renewal_Proposal_v1.pdf, Lynx_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0126

--
Note: Pricing figures in the proposal reflect committed monthly tokens; usage above commit will follow the overage schedule in the attached PDF.

From: Sara Patel <sara@lynxretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Holt <ben.holt@lynxretail.com>, Priya Singh <psingh@lynxretail.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Lynx Retail — renewal: proposed term structure, hosted commit & billing path

Thanks Hannah —

Appreciate the clear options. Quick notes from our side after a brief sync with Ben and procurement:

- Procurement (Priya) will need the final SOW and commercial terms to run through our PO process. Please copy procurement@lynxretail.com on the final contract.
- Ben (CFO) asked whether we can see an example monthly billing breakout and a simple 12/24 month TCO comparison table. The PDF is helpful, but he wants an explicit per-month cash flow view.
- We're interested in Option B but need a stronger commercial concession on the overage cap — would Redwood consider capping overage unit price at no more than 1.5x the committed unit rate for months with seasonal spikes?

Also, security asked about log retention and access to audit logs for a 12-month window. Can you point us to the relevant SOC2 artifacts or a contact on the security team?

If we can get a firm pricing addendum and a DocuSign-ready SOW early next week, I can route it through Ben for sign-off.

On a related note: we may also want a short pilot to test the increased per-route QPS on checkout during Black Friday traffic (if we go Option B). Can we schedule a call to scope that?

Thanks —
Sara
Head of Product Operations
Lynx Retail
Sara.Patel@lynxretail.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Lynx Retail — renewal: proposed term structure, hosted commit & billing path

Hannah / Marissa —

Forwarding Sara's note and my recommended commercial approach:

Proposal recommendation (to present to Lynx):
1) Primary offer: 24-month (Option B) with 2.25M tokens/month committed. Provide a 15% net discount year 1 and a 6% onboarding credit as proposed.
2) Overage concession: cap overage unit price at 1.5x committed unit price for seasonal months (limited to 3 months per contract year) — this addresses Ben's cash-flow concern while protecting our margin.
3) Billing clarity: produce a month-by-month TCO spreadsheet (see related link) that shows committed spend, estimated overages at three spike scenarios, and enterprise credit amortization.
4) Security artifacts: share the SOC2 summary + Redwood security contact (security-biz@redwoodinference.com) and provide a timeboxed evidence bundle for procurement.
5) Pilot: offer a pre-Black-Friday pilot window — 2-week elevated-QPS test on the checkout route with engineering support and SLA on data retention for test logs.

Operational asks for agreement:
- Marissa: please assemble the Draft_SOW_Lynx_2026.docx and fee table; include the 3-month capped overage language and the pilot appendix.
- Hannah: I can prepare the HubSpot update and the DocuSign envelope once SOW is ready. Link to deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8421

If Lynx signs for Option B we should lock the pricing for 90 days to give them time for procurement.

-Karthik
Account Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Hi Sara / Ben / Priya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Karthik's suggestion, below is a concise next-steps list and what you should expect from us by Monday:

1) Final commercial package: we'll produce the SOW + Amendment reflecting the 24-month Option B pricing and the overage-cap concession (overage <= 1.5x committed unit rate, limited to 3 months/year).
2) Monthly TCO: attached will be a per-month billing breakout that shows committed fees, amortized credits, and three spike scenarios (low / expected / heavy).
3) Security/procurement: we've queued the SOC2 artifact packet and assigned security-biz@redwoodinference.com to export the evidence bundle. Priya — please confirm any additional documents required beyond SOC2 and retention policy.
4) Pilot scope: engineering will own the 2-week elevated-QPS pilot; I'll have Marissa send a 1-page playbook and an ops contact list.
5) DocuSign: we'll route the DocuSign envelope to procurement@lynxretail.com + Ben's CFO email once SOW is finalized. See test envelope link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc123-lynx-renewal

Attachments on this message: Draft_SOW_Lynx_2026.docx (draft), Lynx_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (updated MAP).

If that plan works, can you confirm procurement's target PO date so we can lock pricing for 90 days?
